name: William Wallace
original_name: ウィリアム・ウォレス
source:
A hero imprisoned in Valhalla, the realm of infinite healing and madness.

In her original world, she dedicated herself to fighting for the freedom of her homeland. Due to power struggles and betrayal by her allies, she was captured by an enemy nation and was apparently scheduled for execution.
